description: Get company registry profile and headline financials for one latest filed period (`financials.period_to` / `financial_period_to`): revenue, profit, costs, assets, estimated_value (Ohlson/RIM equity estimate), PKD, address, plus contacts when on record, full address, share capital, representation, recent KRS changes and `vat` (MF white list: VAT status, VAT registration date, bank accounts, removal/restoration, date Compabase checked it). All money fields in this response are that same period — there is no nested summary from a different year. NIP lookup also returns a CEIDG/JDG firm when it has a public contact email (RODO). Does NOT include balance-sheet line items (cash, receivables, inventories). For those or earlier years, use get_financials.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, dashes optional).

name: get_company
title: Get Company Profile
